description: Members the spec lists as `required` that the live API omits (observed 2026-10-05 against api.anthropic.com with an inference key, claude-haiku-4-5-20251001): a plain text reply leaves out `usage.output_tokens_details` and `usage.server_tool_use` on POST /v1/messages and `content[].citations` on its text blocks; the beta route (POST /v1/messages?beta=true) additionally leaves out `context_management` and `usage.fallback_credit` / `iterations` / `speed`; GET /v1/models?beta=true leaves out `allowed_fallback_models`. Each is nullable with `default: null` in the spec — the server omits it rather than sending null. Dropped from the `required` lists (nullability unchanged) so strict response validation accepts the real responses: Usage −output_tokens_details −server_tool_use; ResponseTextBlock −citations; BetaMessage −context_management; BetaResponseTextBlock −citations; BetaUsage −fallback_credit −iterations −output_tokens_details −server_tool_use −speed; BetaModelInfo −allowed_fallback_models.
